name: singlet_spatial_preproc_spatial_contamination_removal
title: Remove ambient and neighbour contamination from spatial units
description: Removes ambient background and neighbour spot-swapping from spatial spot or bin counts, writing decontaminated counts and a per-unit contamination fraction. Use it on Visium or Visium HD style units with coordinates and background units; the default spotclean method fits a spatial bleed model and background_subtraction is a faster heuristic. Do not use it on segmented cells or transcripts (use transcript cell assignment) or on droplet data without coordinates.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path or URI (local path, s3://, r2://, https://) or a workspace handle.

layer.description: Raw UMI count layer to decontaminate, units by genes.

method.description: spotclean fits the spatial bleed model (default for Visium and Visium HD); background_subtraction is the heuristic baseline.

background_key.description: obs column marking background units (off-tissue or empty regions); falls back to not in_tissue when absent.

negative_control_key.description: var column of negative-control features for imaging panels; background_subtraction only. Null uses background units.

spotclean.description: Options for method spotclean; ignored by background_subtraction.

candidate_radius.description: Candidate bleed kernel radii in units of the spacing between adjacent spots; the radius with the smallest residual is kept.

gene_cutoff.description: Minimum average expression for a gene to be decontaminated.

background_model.description: off_tissue takes the profile from background units; joint also fits it from tissue units (proposed).

device.description: Execution device; auto picks CUDA when a device with enough memory is available.

dry_run.description: Return estimated time, memory and device without writing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: ran inline and wrote members; dry_run: only an estimate was computed; queued: running as a long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written. Empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Keys: method, radius, bleed_rate, distal_rate, median_contamination_fraction, arc_before, arc_after, n_background_units. Radius and rates are null under background_subtraction.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
